study: Capsule Review: supervised domain adaptation with examination-separated development
context: Galar v2 corrected 2025-12-15 blood label; existing 512 sparsely selected source frames per examination, NOT continuous video; historical examples only, never clinical or independent patient evaluation
label: blood only; explicitly marked 0/1, negative does not mean absence of other pathology
fold_policy: train anew on other 7 fitting examinations; evaluate only selected held-out fitting examination. The two selected folds each contain >=20 positives. No checkpoint/algorithm selection based on historically inspected 9-10.
reserved_examinations: 11-20 not acquired and 61-80 authors' holdout unopened
fine_tune_architecture: torchvision mobilenet_v3_small ImageNet V1; freeze features[0:11]; unfreeze features[11:13] and replace classification head with 576-to-1 linear classifier; freeze early batch norm statistics
preprocessing: RGB, deterministic bicubic full-field resize to 160x160, tensor in [0,1], ImageNet V1 mean/std; no crop or augmentation. Preserve circular field of view.

training.positive_weight_rule: min(10.0, n_negative / n_positive) computed only on the current training examinations
training.epoch_selection: Use fixed epoch 3; no early stopping, no development-based selection
training.precision: float32 CPU; deterministic algorithms and seeded shuffled train batches

training_only_comparators: official frozen MobileNetV3-small feature extraction + train-fold-only standardized weighted logistic head, L2=0.01
metrics: top-k blood-positive sampled images at budgets 5/10/25/50/75/100 percent
review_budget_denominator: 512 sparse sampled frames per examination; no inference about full examination, clinical time, or distinct lesions
final_fit: Fit same fixed 3-epoch architecture on all training examinations 1-8, then perform exactly one descriptive historical comparison on 9-10. Do not choose model based on those development cases.
promotion_rule: Do not replace original blood CNN based on historical development results; without genuinely new examination-level evaluation both models stay exploratory candidates
artifact_policy: Commit only fixed specification, reproducible code/tests and aggregate results; store original images, source manifests, model weights, per-image predictions and viewer data outside GitHub
known_limitations: Small and sparse sample; 208/239 training positives in one exam; unknown unique-patient identity; binary blood annotation is not a diagnosis; development exams previously inspected; distribution shifts and variation uncertain
license_policy: Preserve original research dataset attribution; do not add a software license or publish app without user decision
